rows.note: Use 精 for a concentrated substance such as vanilla extract or another flavouring extract.

example.english: This vanilla extract smells great; a little is enough.
example.traditional: 呢樽雲呢拿精好香，落少少已經夠。
example.jyutping: ne1 zeon1 wan6 nei1 naa4 zing1 hou2 hoeng1 lok6 siu2 siu2 ji5 ging1 gau3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for forcibly pulling a solid object out, such as a tooth, splinter, or stump.

example.english: The dentist will extract my wisdom tooth tomorrow.
example.traditional: 聽日牙醫會拔出我隻智慧齒。
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 ngaa4 ji1 wui5 bat6 ceot1 ngo5 zek3 zi3 wai6 ci2

rows.note: Use 節錄 as the all-purpose choice for an excerpt taken from a book, document, or recording.

example.english: Here is an extract from the report for everyone to read first.
example.traditional: 以下係份報告嘅節錄，大家可以先睇住。
example.jyutping: ji5 haa6 hai6 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 zit3 luk6 daai6 gaa1 ho2 ji5 sin1 tai2 zyu6

rows.note: Use 引文 specifically when the extract is being quoted or cited as someone else's words.

example.english: The article contains an extract of a famous person's words, and it is quite inspiring.
example.traditional: 篇文入面有句名人講過嘅引文，幾有啟發性。
example.jyutping: pin1 man4 jap6 min6 jau5 geoi3 ming4 jan4 gong2 gwo3 ge3 jan5 man4 gei2 jau5 kai2 faat3 sing3

rows.note: Use this for drawing a liquid, oil, or other substance out through a mechanical or processing method.

example.english: This machine can extract oil from coffee beans.
example.traditional: 呢部機可以抽出咖啡豆入面嘅油。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 gei1 ho2 ji5 cau1 ceot1 gaa3 fe1 dau2 jap6 min6 ge3 jau4

rows.note: Use this mainly in writing for reproducing a selected passage or snippet from a text.

example.english: The editor decided to extract a passage from the report.
example.traditional: 編輯決定節錄報告入面一段。
example.jyutping: pin1 cap1 kyut3 ding6 zit3 luk6 bou3 gou3 jap6 min6 jat1 dyun6
